steps.code:
access_token = login_result['access_token']

# Fetch all recommended songs. The API supports pagination with page_limit up to 20.
all_recommendations = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print(f"Page {page_index}: {len(page)} songs")
    if not page:
        break
    all_recommendations.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total recommended songs: {len(all_recommendations)}")
print(all_recommendations[:3])
